decisions.reason: As a close-to-core door lever handle family that remained visible after launch, it likely met at least modest aspiration levels and a large growing firm has enough slack to retain a proven line extension.

This door handle design also appears to have survived its introduction, but as a narrower single design rather than a broader family it is somewhat more exposed if results only hover around aspiration levels.

The electronic access system is a flagship product closely aligned with the firm's stated move toward digital building organization, so management is likely to tolerate some uncertainty and keep backing it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.
